## Change

Describe the problem, the selected scope, and the resulting behavior.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] I considered Rust/Python parity and wire compatibility where applicable.
- [ ] I preserved Native Architecture-First and role-neutral scope.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private planning, publication steps, or unsupported readiness claims.
- [ ] The proposed head descends from the fixed adoption baseline, and every commit after it has an author-matching DCO 1.1 sign-off; additional sign-offs are distinct and valid.
- [ ] The proposed merge strategy preserves a checked final commit (`rebase`/fast-forward, or a separately signed and checked squash commit).

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Add or update regression tests for behavior changes.
